read.thesis: FY26 record orders up 25% to €108.2bn (book-to-bill 1.30) and EPS pre PPA of €11.76 beat the raised €11.20–11.50 guide; FY27 EPS pre PPA guided €10.20–10.80 on a Healthineers-excluded basis.

triggers.label: Orders up 25% to €108.2bn
triggers.quote: Comparable orders in fiscal 2026 increased 25 percent to a record €108.2 billion

triggers.label: Book-to-bill 1.30; backlog €143bn
triggers.quote: The book-to-bill ratio was an excellent 1.30 (fiscal 2025: 1.12). At €143 billion, the order backlog also set a new record

triggers.label: EPS pre PPA beat raised guide
triggers.quote: EPS pre PPA totaled €11.76 (fiscal 2025: €12.95) and exceeded the guidance that the company had raised in Q3 to between €11.20 and €11.50

triggers.label: FY27 EPS pre PPA €10.20–10.80
triggers.quote: Siemens anticipates basic EPS from net income before purchase price allocation accounting (EPS pre PPA) in a range of €10.20 to €10.80 in fiscal 2027

guidance.quote: For the Siemens Group, the company expects comparable revenue growth in the range of 9 percent to 11 percent and a book-to-bill ratio above 1.
Siemens anticipates basic EPS from net income before purchase price allocation accounting (EPS pre PPA) in a range of €10.20 to €10.80 in fiscal 2027.
comparable revenue growth is now expected to be between 7 percent and 11 percent (previously: 6 percent and 9 percent)

prior_guidance_check.quote: EPS pre PPA totaled €11.76 (fiscal 2025: €12.95) and exceeded the guidance that the company had raised in Q3 to between €11.20 and €11.50.

red_flags.label: FY27 EPS guide below FY26 comparable base
red_flags.quote: Comparable EPS pre PPA, that is excluding Siemens Healthineers, was €9.27 in fiscal 2026.

red_flags.label: Reported net income down on prior-year gain
red_flags.quote: Net income reached €9.5 billion (fiscal 2025: €10.4 billion). The prior-year figure had included a gain of €2.1 billion
